raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## What does this PR do?

Move `test_fused_mhc_kernels.py` into a dedicated latest H100 unit-test bucket and launch it with one worker. These local kernel/reference comparisons perform no distributed communication; the current eight-worker launch repeats compilation and autotuning on every rank. In [this H100 run](https://github.com/NVIDIA/Megatron-LM/actions/runs/37801915793/job/113414234172), four backward cases consumed about 444 seconds of the general bucket's pytest runtime.

The existing bucket finder excludes the file from the general bucket once it has its own entry. All numerical cases, assertions, tolerances, and node IDs are unchanged. Legacy continues to use its own checkout's recipe.

Full runs, Testmon baseline generation, and selected runs all use the same recipe and worker count. Testmon runtime metadata now includes world size, rejecting incompatible caches and using the existing full-run fallback. A selected node ID can run independently with an empty compiler cache. Existing baselines need regeneration after the compatibility inputs change.

The runner allocation remains eight GPUs; this change removes duplicate test processes and shortens the general bucket's critical path. It does not change scheduling to allocate a single-GPU runner. This PR is independent of the other unit-test runtime changes.

## Validation

- CPU suites: `python -m pytest -q -o addopts= tests/test_utils/test_unit_testmon.py tests/test_utils/test_unit_testmon_cache.py tests/test_utils/test_testmon_workflow.py` — 170 passed, 8 failed. All eight failures are existing `test_pr_label_gate` cases and reproduce with the unmodified base test file; they reference variables no longer used by the current workflow.
- New checks exercise recipe partitioning, worker counts in full/baseline/enforce modes, real single-worker Testmon baseline and dependency selection, and rejection of 8-to-1 and 1-to-8 cache reuse.
- Standalone cold-cache `TestTritonHPostBDA::test_bwd_vs_reference[128-1-8-7168-True]` passed on RTX 6000 Ada in 232.04 seconds. H100 performance savings remain to be measured in CI.
- `BASE_REF=main CHECK_ONLY=true SKIP_DOCS=false bash tools/autoformat.sh`: Black, isort, Pylint and Ruff passed. The script's nonblocking mypy step reports missing PyYAML stubs.
- `git diff --check` passed.

## Contribution process

- [x] Added relevant regression tests.
- [x] Ran the repository autoformatter checks.
- Production GPU kernels are unchanged.

 ROOT = Path(__file__).parents[2]
 
 
+def test_mhc_kernel_file_has_one_recipe_bucket(monkeypatch, capsys):
+    recipe = yaml.safe_load((ROOT / "tests/test_utils/recipes/h100/unit-tests.yaml").read_text())
+    buckets = [case for product in recipe["products"] for case in product["test_case"]]
+    kernel_file = "tests/unit_tests/fusions/test_fused_mhc_kernels.py"
+    assert buckets.count(kernel_file) == 1
+
+    spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location(
+        "mhc_test_case_finder", ROOT / "tests/unit_tests/find_test_cases.py"
+    )
+    assert spec is not None and spec.loader is not None
+    finder = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
+    spec.loader.exec_module(finder)
+    monkeypatch.chdir(ROOT)
+    monkeypatch.setattr(finder, "get_test_cases", lambda _: buckets)
+
+    for bucket, excluded in [("tests/unit_tests/**/*.py", True), (kernel_file, False)]:
+        monkeypatch.setattr(sys, "argv", ["find_test_cases.py", bucket, "h100"])
+        finder.main()
+        ignored = capsys.readouterr().out.splitlines()
+        assert (f"--ignore={kernel_file}" in ignored) is excluded
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("mode", ["full", "baseline", "enforce"])
+@pytest.mark.parametrize(
+    "bucket,workers",
+    [
+        ("tests/unit_tests/fusions/test_fused_mhc_kernels.py", 1),
+        ("tests/unit_tests/**/*.py", 8),
+        ("tests/unit_tests/generalized_tensor_parallel/**/*.py", 4),
+    ],
+)
+def test_unit_recipe_worker_count_is_shared_by_baseline_and_consumers(
+    tmp_path, mode, bucket, workers
+):
+    recipe = yaml.safe_load((ROOT / "tests/test_utils/recipes/h100/unit-tests.yaml").read_text())
+    script = recipe["spec"]["script"].format(
+        tag="latest", environment="dev", test_case=bucket, n_repeat=1, assets_dir=tmp_path
+    )
+    # Execute the recipe, intercepting filesystem operations and the GPU harness.
+    stubs = '\n'.join(
+        (
+            'rm() { :; }',
+            'ls() { :; }',
+            'cd() { :; }',
+            'bash() { printf "workers=%s\\n" "$GPUS_PER_NODE" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"; }',
+        )
+    )
+    result, outputs = _run(
+        stubs + "\n" + script, tmp_path, {"UNIT_TESTMON_MODE": mode, "GPUS_PER_NODE": "8"}
+    )
+    assert result.returncode == 0, result.stdout + result.stderr
+    assert outputs["workers"] == str(workers)
+
+
 def _step(workflow: str, job: str, step_id: str) -> dict:
     document = yaml.safe_load((ROOT / ".github/workflows" / workflow).read_text())
     return next(step for step in document["jobs"][job]["steps"] if step.get("id") == step_id)

         assert _snapshot(cache / "prod") == before
 
 
+def test_single_worker_baseline_and_dependency_selection(project, tmp_path):
+    cache = tmp_path / "single-worker-cache"
+    baseline = _invoke(project, cache, "baseline", world_size=1)
+    assert baseline.returncode == 0, baseline.stdout + baseline.stderr
+    metadata = json.loads((cache / "prod/metadata.json").read_text())
+    assert metadata["runtime"]["world_size"] == 1
+    before = _snapshot(cache / "prod")
+
+    selected = _invoke(project, cache, "select", world_size=1)
+    assert selected.returncode == 0, selected.stdout + selected.stderr
+    selection = cache / ".testmon-work/prod/rank-0/selected-tests"
+    assert selection.read_text() == ""
+
+    # Selection must find the affected case without executing its failing assertion.
+    (project / "app.py").write_text("def active(value):\n    return value + 2\n")
+    selected = _invoke(project, cache, "select", world_size=1)
+    assert selected.returncode == 0, selected.stdout + selected.stderr
+    assert selection.read_text().splitlines() == ["tests/test_app.py::test_active"]
+    assert _snapshot(cache / "prod") == before
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("producer_world_size,consumer_world_size", [(8, 1), (1, 8)])
+def test_selection_rejects_a_different_baseline_world_size(
+    project, tmp_path, producer_world_size, consumer_world_size
+):
+    cache = tmp_path / "world-size-cache"
+    baseline = _invoke(project, cache, "baseline", world_size=producer_world_size)
+    assert baseline.returncode == 0, baseline.stdout + baseline.stderr
+    before = _snapshot(cache / "prod")
+
+    selected = _invoke(project, cache, "select", world_size=consumer_world_size)
+    assert selected.returncode != 0
+    assert "Testmon runtime environment changed" in selected.stdout + selected.stderr
+    assert not (cache / ".testmon-work").exists()
+    assert _snapshot(cache / "prod") == before
+
+
